parameters.name: byteQuantMode
parameters.description: Empirically-derived lighting byteQuantMode (Phase 17 D-06/D-08, RENDTOL-02). 17-CAPTURE-RESULTS-ROUND1.md's Round 1 capture measured maxAbsDelta=0.0 for lighting (contentHashMatch=true), giving a divergence-absorption floor of N=0 -- but that capture is now known to have measured a degenerate solid-black render caused by a push-constant field-order bug (fixed in Phase 17-06: lighting_fragment_shader.glsl's push_constant struct now matches ResolveUniforms's alphabetical packing order), so it is NOT a valid basis for real cross-hardware divergence and a fresh capture against the corrected shader is still pending. secv01_render_lighting_counter_test.cpp's own binary search over N in [0,8] against a deliberately wrong lightColor ([1,1,1] -> [0.5,0.5,0.5]) found the counter-test passes through N=5 and fails (artifactIds collide) at N=6 -- N=5 is chosen as one integer step of margin below that confirmed failure boundary. This value is honestly derived from the counter-test's own corruption-detection boundary, not from a fresh real-divergence measurement for the corrected shader.
